rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing a practice or level that cannot continue long term.

example.english: Running the business by relying on overtime is operating unsustainably.
example.traditional: 靠加班頂住盤生意，係唔可持續咁運作。
example.jyutping: kaau3 gaa1 baan1 ding2 zyu6 pun4 saang1 ji3 hai6 m4 ho2 ci4 zuk6 gam3 wan6 zok3

rows.note: Use this when warning that continuing in the current way will not work or cannot last.

example.english: If we carry on unsustainably like this, the shop will soon go under.
example.traditional: 咁樣落去，間舖好快會捱唔住㗎。
example.jyutping: gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3 gaan1 pou3 hou2 faai3 wui5 ngaai4 m4 zyu6 gaa3
